intended_contract.test_claim: CONFIRM is frozen and selection-independent: post-loop fix/surgery validate on data the loop never mined.
intended_contract.documentation_claim: Hypotheses are mined on EXPLORE and fixes are validated on CONFIRM cases the loop never used to pick them.

observed_execution_path: VLDiagnoseLoop.run_fix deterministically re-splits the original batch and passes the CONFIRM CaseBatch to FixAgent.propose_and_validate.
FixAgent.propose_and_validate chooses its validation subset from that same CaseBatch and computes the baseline on it before proposing fixes.
FixAgent._propose extracts up to 1000 characters of prompts specifically from FAIL-labeled cases in that same CaseBatch and passes those examples to L1/L2/coded candidate generation.
When max_repair_rounds > 1, later proposals receive prior validation results from the same CaseBatch, including fixed/broken counts; heterogeneous failures include exact helped/hurt case IDs.
When auto_escalate is enabled, prior non-fixed attempts from earlier tiers are passed into later tiers, again while all tiers validate on the same CONFIRM CaseBatch.

FixAgent._validate then computes paired candidate-vs-baseline statistics and an e-value on that same CaseBatch. e-BH is finally applied across the accumulated candidate family, including the union across auto-escalated tiers.

statistical_scope.what_is_established: The implementation uses an anytime-valid Bernoulli e-value for a paired McNemar-style comparison and standard e-BH over a family of e-values.
statistical_scope.what_is_not_established: The code does not establish that the e-value for each fix remains a valid null e-value after the fix definition has been adapted using the same CONFIRM cases/outcomes on which that e-value is computed. Arbitrary dependence among already-valid e-values is not by itself a proof of same-data post-selection validity.
do_not_infer: Do not infer that the e-BH implementation itself is incorrect.
Do not infer that any published or local EvalVitals result is necessarily false.
Do not infer that every adaptively proposed fix overfits in practice.
The finding is source-bound to the inspected public execution path at the pinned commit.

surfaces: EXPLORE: hypothesis discovery and diagnostic examples
TUNE: adaptive fix proposal, repair feedback, tier escalation and routing
CERTIFY: frozen-candidate paired comparison; no candidate-generation feedback from this surface
OUTER: final one-shot generalization surface never used by proposal, certification, rollback, routing, stopping or recovery
minimal_repair_contract.alternative_if_certify_must_be_reused: Use a formally reusable/online-valid selection mechanism with an explicit feedback/query budget; do not treat ordinary e-BH over same-data adaptively generated candidate e-values as sufficient by itself.
required_instrumentation: immutable candidate identity before CERTIFY query
query ledger proving candidate was frozen before certification outcomes were visible
feedback-channel ledger proving CERTIFY outcomes/identities were not returned to proposer before terminal certification
separate OUTER query ledger with zero pre-final queries

arms: EXPLORE/TUNE/CERTIFY with candidate frozen before CERTIFY
EXPLORE/TUNE/CERTIFY/OUTER with one-shot frozen outer evaluation
measure: certification false-positive rate under null/placebo fixes

exact_next_action: Search for a public self-improvement/repair system that explicitly separates adaptive TUNE from frozen CERTIFY and a never-touched OUTER surface while retaining candidate-local anytime-valid evidence. In parallel, track EvalVitals main/issues/PRs for a repair that freezes the candidate before CONFIRM or adds a third surface; if such a revision appears, re-audit the exact executable path rather than assuming the label 'held-out' implies selection independence. Continue the Harn provider-accepted-before-checkpoint hard-kill frontier if a new relevant public revision appears.
